title: How Heat Pumps Reduce Energy Bills and Air Pollution in the San Francisco Bay Area
summary: RMI models Bay Area homes under PG&E's 2026 rates and finds most save by replacing gas water heaters and furnaces with heat pumps.

assertions.quote: they are typically more than three times more efficient than gas water heaters
When a home replaces both its gas water heater and its gas furnace with heat pumps, nearly 90% of homes still see lower bills
When this efficiency is paired with beneficial electric rates, the savings grow.
heating homes with heat pumps can put downward pressure on electricity rates

verdicts.note: In summer-peaking systems added winter sales spread fixed costs, but in winter-peaking regions heat pumps can drive new grid investment.
Electrification raises electricity sales, which helps pay for infrastructure and potentially puts downward pressure on retail rates.
Where networks have spare capacity, added demand may be beneficial by raising utilization of existing transmission and distribution.
